`TRAIN_SEED` changes the FiLM network initialisation and the minibatch / collocation-point order.  The per-snapshot latents are initialised DETERMINISTICALLY from the top-K POD coefficients, so latent init does NOT vary; neither do the data draw, the split or the `TEST_SEED` test set.

The POD basis is a deterministic function of the TRAIN snapshots, so the POD control carries no training-seed variance (any spread in its row is solver non-determinism only).
